Bring the filled form, originals, one set of self-attested photocopies and one recent passport-size color photograph to the interview.
Report at C-101, Guest House, IISER Pune Campus on 18.11.2026 at 10.00 AM.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Job Description
content_sections.text: Technical Officer / Lead (Science Communication & Technical Writing) Lead the content creation team at SMC. Conceptualize visual storytelling frameworks. Write and review scripts for video series and online modules. Prepare grant applications and institutional annual reports. Oversee digital media communications and media relations. Technical Assistant – Video Post-Production & Editing Edit video lectures, MOOC content, and institutional outreach videos. Handle audio synchronization, basic motion graphics, and multi-cam footage assembly. Archive project media files. Technical Assistant (Graphic Design & Science Illustration) Design high-quality scientific diagrams, publication graphics, cover art, and visual assets for digital media and educational modules. Support the SMC team in visual design projects.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Master's degree in Science in any discipline / Mass Communication / Journalism / Content Writing from a recognized University / Institute. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of demonstrated leadership experience in science communication, scripting educational video content, writing grant proposals, drafting institutional reports, and managing digital outreach strategies. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 50,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s. Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in Visual Communication / Mass Communication / Media Production OR Any Graduate degree with a Diploma in Video Editing / Post-Production from a recognized Institute. Experience required: Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in video editing, audio mixing, color grading, and asset management. Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro is essential. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Rs. 32,000 to Rs. 35,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s. Qualification required: Master's degree in Fine Arts / Visual Communication / Graphic Design / Science OR Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts / Visual Communication with a Diploma in Animation/Graphics. Experience required: Minimum 1 year of proven experience in creating scientific illustrations, schematics, cover art for peer-reviewed journals, infographics, and 2D/3D visual assets. Hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Blender, or Maya. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Rs.32,000 to Rs.35,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. Initially for a period of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and the requirements of the position. The appointed person shall have no claim of absorption in IISER Pune.
